card.text: A Cepheid in the Milky Way that swells and shrinks every 13.4 days.

sources.label: Groenewegen (2012)
sources.locator: table10, V916 Aql: Per, Rad, Dist

introduction.text: Its mean radius, 90.7 solar radii, comes from comparing how fast its surface moves with how its size changes, 3,592 parsecs away.
